claims.text: Photos with the same bytes (same SHA-256) are grouped as exact copies, whatever their names.
Photos with different bytes are never called exact copies.
Photos join a look-alike group when their 64-bit difference hashes differ in 5 bits or fewer, and not at 6 or more.
Look-alike groups are named apart from exact groups and say the person should check them.
In each group the largest file is the default one to keep, and every other file is only marked.
Choosing which to keep, or putting a group back, changes the marked list and its count and size exactly.
At most 300 photos are looked at, and empty files and files over 25 MB are skipped with a plain note.
The saved list holds file names only, and nothing is deleted, moved, uploaded or sent.
Messy input never throws and never gives NaN, and a bad entry gets a plain-words problem.
